title: Thanksgiving 2026

tasks.title: Morning check: Tuesday items done?
tasks.details: **Morning check:** Tuesday items done? Both turkeys spatchcocked and drying uncovered on racks in the fridge; gravy base made; cranberry sauce made. If not, do them first.

tasks.title: Bacon, then shallot + spinach
tasks.details: Cook all the bacon (12 oz for quiche + a few extra slices for the mushrooms). Then cook shallot + spinach in 2 tbsp bacon fat; cool and wring the spinach dry.

tasks.title: Oven to 400°F · prick sweet potatoes
tasks.details: Oven to 400°F. Prick the sweet potatoes.

tasks.title: Sweet potatoes in (60 min) · prep mushrooms
tasks.details: Sweet potatoes into the oven on a foil-lined sheet, 60 min. Wipe mushrooms, pull and chop the stems.

tasks.title: Mushroom caps in the oven (10 min)
tasks.details: Mushroom caps into the oven gill-side down next to the sweet potatoes, 10 min.

tasks.title: Flip caps · stems + filling · fill caps
tasks.details: Flip the caps, pour off the liquid. Cook stems + garlic in butter until dry; cool; make the filling; fill caps; crumb topping; cover; fridge.

tasks.title: Sweet potatoes out · oven to 375°F
tasks.details: Sweet potatoes out. Oven to 375°F for the quiche crust. Scoop and mash the filling, spread in a buttered 9×13, cover, fridge. Bag the pecan topping separately.

tasks.title: Blind-bake the quiche crust
tasks.details: Blind-bake the quiche crust: 15 min with weights, then 5–8 min without.

tasks.title: Crust out · oven to 350°F · quiche in
tasks.details: Crust out; oven to 350°F. Layer cheese, bacon, spinach, cheese; pour the custard. Quiche in on a sheet pan, 45–55 min.

tasks.title: Check the quiche · pull and cool
tasks.details: Check the quiche: edges set, center slightly jiggly. Pull it and cool 1 hr, then cover and refrigerate (reminder at 13:15).

tasks.title: Lunch break
tasks.details: Lunch break.

tasks.title: Mashed potatoes: peel, boil, mash
tasks.details: Mashed potatoes: peel, boil, mash, into the buttered slow-cooker insert, fridge.

tasks.title: Quiche into the fridge
tasks.details: Quiche into the fridge (quiet reminder).

tasks.title: Check bread cubes · stuffing base
tasks.details: Check the bread cubes. Bottom cubes still soft? Toast at 250°F for 20–30 min first. Then make the stuffing base: sausage, vegetables, toss with bread, split into the two foil pans, cover, fridge. **No eggs or stock yet.**

tasks.title: Assemble green bean casserole
tasks.details: Green bean casserole: assemble the 4-can version in a 9×13, cover, fridge. Keep the remaining onions sealed.

tasks.title: Cocktail sauce · thaw/poach shrimp
tasks.details: Cocktail sauce; thaw the shrimp (and poach if raw); fridge.

tasks.title: Set the table · side table · cooler
tasks.details: Set the table; put a sticky note in each serving dish with its name. Clear the side table for guest food. Set up the drinks cooler.

tasks.title: Equipment check (big bird, pellets, gas)
tasks.details: **Equipment check:** spatchcocked big bird fits flat on the Traeger? Pellets full plus a spare bag? Probe thermometer batteries? Propane tank has gas? Empty cooler + old towels ready for the turkey hold?

tasks.title: Bedtime fridge check
tasks.details: **Bedtime fridge check:** everything covered except the turkeys, which stay uncovered on racks.

tasks.title: Butter out to soften
tasks.details: Butter out to soften for the herb butter (2.5 sticks: 1 for the oven bird, 1.5 for the Traeger bird).

tasks.title: Turkeys out · pellets · herb butter
tasks.details: Turkeys out of the fridge. Check the pellet hopper is full. Make the herb butter.

tasks.title: Herb butter on the 19.4 lb bird
tasks.details: Herb butter on the 19.4 lb bird: half under the skin, half on top. Rack over a sheet pan with onion, carrot, celery, and 2 cups stock.

tasks.title: Traeger on at 325°F
tasks.details: Start the Traeger at 325°F, lid closed. Melt butter for basting.

tasks.title: 19.4 lb turkey on the Traeger
tasks.details: **19.4 lb turkey on the Traeger.** Probe in the thickest part of the breast, not touching bone.

tasks.title: Herb butter on the 15.6 lb bird
tasks.details: Herb butter on the 15.6 lb bird; rack over a sheet pan with vegetables and stock.

tasks.title: Oven to 425°F · casseroles out
tasks.details: Oven to 425°F. Casseroles (stuffing pans, sweet potato, green beans) out of the fridge to take the chill off.

tasks.title: 15.6 lb turkey into the 425°F oven
tasks.details: **15.6 lb turkey into the 425°F oven**, middle rack, probe in the breast. Rotate the pan once halfway (~11:05). Tent the breast if it browns too fast. Baste the Traeger bird.

tasks.title: Potatoes into slow cooker · gravy pot
tasks.details: Mashed potatoes into the slow cooker on LOW with 2 tbsp butter on top. Gravy base into a pot on the stove (not heated yet). Quiche out of the fridge. Check pellets.

tasks.title: Rotate the oven turkey pan
tasks.details: Rotate the oven turkey pan.

tasks.title: Baste the Traeger bird
tasks.details: Baste the Traeger bird.

tasks.title: Baste oven bird · stuffing wet mix
tasks.details: Baste the oven turkey. **Stuffing:** whisk 4 eggs into 4 cups stock, pour over both pans, toss, add stock until moist, soak 15 min. Clear the side table; drinks cooler out.

tasks.title: Stir the mashed potatoes
tasks.details: **Repeat every 30 min:** stir the mashed potatoes; add warm milk if stiff.

tasks.title: Check the oven turkey temp
tasks.details: Check the oven turkey temp: target 160°F breast / 175°F thigh.

tasks.title: Oven turkey OUT · oven 375°F · stuffing in
tasks.details: **Oven turkey OUT** once at temp (if not, leave it in; see fallback below). Tent with foil + towel, or hold it in the empty cooler with towels. Crack the oven door to drop to **375°F**. **Stuffing in, covered**, one pan per rack. Check the Traeger bird temp.

tasks.title: Mushrooms out · baste Traeger bird
tasks.details: Stuffed mushrooms out of the fridge. Baste the Traeger bird.

tasks.title: Light the propane grill (~375°F)
tasks.details: Light the propane grill: **one side only**, lid closed, aim for ~375°F.

tasks.title: Uncover the stuffing
tasks.details: **Uncover the stuffing** for its last 20–30 min.

tasks.title: Mushrooms on the grill (unlit side)
tasks.details: **Mushrooms on the grill**, metal sheet pan on the **unlit side**, lid closed, 15–20 min.

tasks.title: Traeger turkey OFF · Traeger shut down
tasks.details: **Traeger turkey OFF** when breast 160°F / thigh 175°F. Tent loosely; rest 30–45 min. Save the drippings. Shut the Traeger down.

tasks.title: Stuffing out · casseroles in at 350°F
tasks.details: **Stuffing OUT** (center 165°F); keep covered. Crack the oven door to drop to **350°F**. **Sweet potato casserole (topping on) + green bean casserole in.**

tasks.title: Mushrooms off the grill · grill off
tasks.details: Mushrooms off the grill when bubbling and golden; grill off.

tasks.title: Guests arrive · appetizers out
tasks.details: **Guests arrive.** Shrimp on ice with sauce and lemon; quiche, mushrooms, and cranberry sauce out. Desserts to the side table, drinks in the cooler.

tasks.title: Heat the gravy · add drippings slowly
tasks.details: Heat the gravy; whisk in strained drippings **a little at a time, tasting**. The injected birds make salty drippings.

tasks.title: Green beans: stir + onions · start carving
tasks.details: Green beans: stir, top with the remaining fried onions, back in for 5 min. **Start carving, oven turkey first.**

tasks.title: Casseroles out · oven off
tasks.details: Casseroles out. Final stir of the potatoes. Oven off.

tasks.title: Everything to the table · gravy in pitcher
tasks.details: Everything to the table. Gravy into a warmed pitcher.

tasks.title: Dinner! 🦃
tasks.details: **Dinner.** 🦃

tasks.title: Leftovers into the fridge
tasks.details: Leftovers into the fridge (food safety: within ~2 hrs).

recipes.name: Herb butter
recipes.yield: 2.5 batches (1 for the 15.6 lb bird, 1.5 for the 19.4 lb bird)
ingredients: 1 tbsp each chopped sage, thyme, rosemary
steps: Mash everything together.
Rub half under the skin, half on top. **No salt**; the birds are pre-injected.

recipes.name: Two spatchcocked turkeys (Traeger + oven)
recipes.when: Spatchcocked and drying since Tuesday; cook Thursday.
ingredients: Rack over a rimmed sheet pan / roasting pan
steps: Hickory, apple, or turkey-blend pellets; keep a spare bag nearby (cold air burns pellets faster).
Baste with melted butter hourly. Add stock if the pan runs dry.
425°F, middle rack, ~100–110 min.
Rotate once halfway.
Tent the breast if it browns too fast.
Breast 160°F, thigh 175°F (carryover takes the breast to 165°F).
Rest 30–45 min (the oven bird rests ~80 min; hold it in a cooler with towels to keep it hot).
**Go by the probe, not the clock.**
notes: Pre-injected, so no brine, no salt.
Save the drippings from both pans for the gravy.

recipes.name: Make-ahead turkey gravy
ingredients: 10 cups low-sodium chicken or turkey bone broth
optional: necks, giblets (not the liver), backbones, 1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stalk, thyme, 1 bay leaf
steps: Optional: simmer the broth with the necks, backbones, vegetables, and herbs for 1 hr; strain.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, cook 3–4 min until peanut-butter colored.
Whisk in the hot broth a ladle at a time; simmer 10 min until it coats a spoon; season; refrigerate.
**Thursday:** reheat; skim and strain in the drippings from both birds **a little at a time, tasting** (salty from the injection); finish with a splash of vinegar.

recipes.name: Mashed potatoes
recipes.when: Make Wednesday; slow cooker Thursday from 11:00.
ingredients: 1.5 cups warm heavy cream or whole milk
steps: Cover with cold, well-salted water; boil 15–20 min until fork-tender.
Drain; steam-dry in the pot 2 min.
Mash or rice; stir in the butter, cream cheese, and sour cream, then the cream; season.
Spread in a buttered slow-cooker insert; refrigerate.
**Thursday:** LOW from 11:00 with 2 tbsp butter on top; stir every 30 min; add warm milk if stiff.

recipes.name: Sourdough sage-and-sausage stuffing
recipes.when: Wednesday steps 1–3 + split into pans; Thursday 11:30 add the wet; bake 12:00.
ingredients: 2 tbsp fresh sage, 1 tbsp fresh thyme, ¼ cup parsley, chopped
steps: Brown the sausage, breaking it up; set aside.
Melt the butter in the same pan; cook the onion and celery 8 min; add the garlic and herbs for 1 min.
Toss the bread, sausage, and vegetables; split between the two buttered pans; cover; refrigerate.
**Thursday 11:30:** whisk the eggs into 4 cups stock; pour over and toss; add more stock until moist but not soggy; soak 15 min.
**Bake at 375°F:** covered 25 min, uncovered 20–30 min, until the center reads 165°F and the top is crisp.
notes: If the bread cubes are still soft Wednesday, toast them at 250°F for 20–30 min first.

recipes.name: Classic green bean casserole
ingredients: 4 cans (14.5 oz) French-style green beans, **drained very well**
2 cans (10.5 oz) Campbell's condensed cream of mushroom soup
about 2⅔ cups French's crispy fried onions (one 6 oz container), divided
steps: Stir the soup, milk, soy sauce, and pepper.
Fold in the beans and half the onions.
Spread in a 9×13; cover; refrigerate. Keep the remaining onions sealed.
**Thursday:** 350°F for 25 min; stir; top with the remaining onions; bake 5 more min.
notes: Press the canned beans in the colander to drain them well so the casserole isn't soupy.

recipes.name: Sweet potato casserole with pecan crumble
recipes.when: Roast and assemble Wednesday; bake Thursday 12:55.
steps: Prick the potatoes; roast on a foil-lined sheet at 400°F for 60 min until very soft.
Scoop and mash with all the filling ingredients.
Spread in a buttered 9×13; cover; refrigerate; topping in a separate bag.
**Thursday:** scatter the topping; 350°F for 35–40 min until set and the pecans are toasted.
notes: Marshmallows on one end for the last 5–10 min if the kids want them (check the label for dyes).

recipes.name: Fresh cranberry-orange sauce
recipes.when: Made Tuesday; out of the fridge Thursday ~13:00.
ingredients: optional cinnamon stick or 1 tsp grated ginger
steps: Zest, then juice the orange.
Simmer the juice, water, maple syrup, salt, and cinnamon.
Add the berries; simmer 8–10 min until most pop.
Off heat, stir in the zest; remove the cinnamon; taste.
Cool; refrigerate (it sets as it cools).
Thursday: serve cold or take the chill off.

recipes.name: Bacon-spinach quiche
recipes.when: Bake Wednesday; out of the fridge Thursday 11:00; served at room temp.
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream + 1 cup whole milk
¾ tsp kosher salt, ¼ tsp pepper, pinch of nutmeg
steps: Blind-bake: prick, line with foil, add weights; 375°F for 15 min; remove the weights; 5–8 min more; drop the oven to 350°F.
Cook the bacon crisp; drain; chop. Keep 2 tbsp fat; cook the shallot 2 min, then the spinach until wilted.
Cool the spinach and wring it out hard in a towel.
Whisk the eggs, cream, milk, salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Half the cheese, then bacon + spinach, then the rest of the cheese; pour the custard over.
On a sheet pan, 350°F for 45–55 min until the edges are set and the center slightly jiggles; tent the crust if needed.
Cool ≥1 hr; cover; refrigerate.

recipes.name: Stuffed mushrooms
ingredients: ~2 lb large white or cremini stuffing mushrooms (~24)
½ cup finely grated Parmesan + 2 tbsp for topping
2 tbsp chopped parsley, 1 tsp chopped thyme
½ cup fine crumbs from the stuffing sourdough
steps: Wipe the mushrooms; pull and finely chop the stems.
Roast the caps gill-side down at 400°F for 10 min; flip; pour off the liquid.
Cook the stems and garlic in 2 tbsp butter 5–6 min until dry; cool.
Mix with the cream cheese, ½ cup Parmesan, herbs, salt, pepper, and bacon.
Fill each cap; toss the crumbs with 1 tbsp melted butter + 2 tbsp Parmesan; press on top.

Cover; refrigerate. **Thursday:** propane grill, one side lit, ~375°F; mushrooms on a **metal** sheet pan on the unlit side, lid closed, 15–20 min until bubbling. For more color, move them over the flame for the last 1–2 min and watch closely.

recipes.name: Shrimp cocktail
recipes.when: Sauce + shrimp prep Wednesday; serve Thursday 13:00.
ingredients: 1 cup ketchup (check the label for dyes)
a few dashes of hot sauce
steps: Stir the sauce together and chill.
Thaw the shrimp in cold water 20–30 min; if raw, poach 2–3 min in simmering salted water with a halved lemon until pink, then into an ice bath; drain; refrigerate.
Thursday 13:00: platter over ice with the sauce and lemon wedges.

fallbacks.title: Oven turkey not at temp by 12:00
body: Leave it in. Bake the stuffing on the Traeger at 350°F after the big bird comes off at 12:45, and the oven stays on schedule for the casseroles.

Applying the fallback re-times those tasks: the oven bird stays in past 12:00, comes out around 12:30 (oven drops to 350°F), the Traeger goes to 350°F at 12:45 instead of shutting down, and the stuffing goes onto the Traeger at 12:50.

actions.label: Apply fallback: stuffing on the Traeger

fallbacks.title: Traeger bird running slow
body: Go by the probe, not the clock. Cold or windy weather adds 20–30 min.

fallbacks.title: Big bird won't lie flat on the Traeger
body: Smoke it whole, 4–4.5 hr, on by 08:30.

The button shifts only the early Traeger-chain tasks (08:00, 08:30, 08:45, 09:15) 45 min earlier. It does not move the whole lane, which would wrongly move the 12:45 shutdown too: the whole bird needs 4–4.5 hr, so it still comes off around 12:30–13:00. Go by the probe.

variants.label: Oven turkey late: stuffing on the Traeger

thu-1200.title: Check Traeger bird temp · oven turkey stays in
thu-1200.details: Oven turkey is **not at temp yet: leave it in.** Stuffing waits (it goes on the Traeger at 12:50). Check the Traeger bird temp.

thu-1245.title: Traeger turkey OFF · Traeger to 350°F
thu-1245.details: **Traeger turkey OFF** when breast 160°F / thigh 175°F. Tent loosely; rest 30–45 min. Save the drippings. **Leave the Traeger on and set it to 350°F** for the stuffing.

thu-1255.title: Casseroles in at 350°F
thu-1255.details: Oven should already be dropping to **350°F**. **Sweet potato casserole (topping on) + green bean casserole in.** (Stuffing is on the Traeger.)

add.title: Oven turkey OUT when at temp
add.details: **Oven turkey OUT** when at temp (breast 160°F / thigh 175°F). Tent with foil + towel, or hold it in the empty cooler with towels. Crack the oven door to drop to **350°F** for the 12:55 casseroles.

add.title: Stuffing onto the Traeger, covered
add.details: **Stuffing onto the Traeger, covered**, at 350°F (both pans). Check center reaches 165°F before it comes off.

add.title: Uncover the stuffing on the Traeger
add.details: **Uncover the stuffing** on the Traeger for its last 20–30 min.

add.title: Stuffing OFF the Traeger · Traeger OFF
add.details: **Stuffing OUT** of the Traeger (center 165°F); keep covered. Traeger OFF.
